scan_interfaces.description: [SWE5] List DCS_X enum entries from IT headers. Saves ~420 lines of header reading.

scan_hooks.description: [SWE5] List SIT_ macros from hook headers. Saves ~200 lines of header reading.

scan_memory.description: [SWE5] SRAM1 usage counts from BBE32 IT source. Saves ~300 lines of source reading.

scan_build.description: [SWE5] IT BUILD target info (alwayslink, select, names). Saves ~150 lines of BUILD reading.

scan_flags.description: [Build System] All bool_flag/string_flag/config_setting from root BUILD. Saves ~200 lines.

scan_streams.description: [IPC] Stream headers and source IDs from software/common/. Saves ~500 lines across 14 headers.

scan_test_targets.description: [Testing] All test targets from root BUILD test_suites (55 R52 + 10 BBE). Saves ~200 lines.

scan_modules.description: [Architecture] Software modules with BUILD/test presence (39 modules). Saves directory traversal.

scan_external_deps.description: [Dependencies] All bazel_dep/local_repository/http_archive from MODULE.bazel. Saves ~322 lines.

scan_coverage_thresholds.description: [Quality] 57 coverage report targets with min thresholds. Saves reading 1054-line coverage/BUILD.

scan_bazelrc.description: [Build Config] 26 flag aliases + 10 config definitions from .bazelrc. Saves ~115 lines.

scan_swcs.description: [AUTOSAR] 27 SWC directories with BUILD targets and test info. Saves ~500 lines of dir+BUILD reads.

scan_includes.description: [Debugging] All #include directives from a source file. Pass file_path relative to repo root. Saves 100-1000 lines per call.

scan_deps.description: [Debugging] Deps/srcs/hdrs for a BUILD target. Pass build_path and optionally target name. Saves 50-400 lines per call.

scan_precommit.description: [Coding Standards] Pre-commit hooks + formatting rules for a file. Pass file_path to check which hooks apply and what format rules to follow. Saves ~150 lines.

scan_functions.description: [Debugging] Function signatures from a .c/.h file. Quick API overview without reading full source. Saves 100-800 lines per call.

scan_defines.description: [Debugging] All #define macros from a header. Understand config/constants without full file read. Saves 50-500 lines per call.

scan_git_changes.description: [Debugging] Modified/staged/untracked files from git status. Know what is being worked on without running git commands.

scan_memory_stats.description: [Debugging] Memory usage stats from build output. Parse bazel-bin/temp/memoryStats.txt without reading raw file.

scan_structs.description: [Data Types] Extract struct/typedef/enum from a header. Pass file_path. Saves reading 200-1000 line headers.

scan_ipc_payload.description: [IPC] M2D/D2M/SIT_Data_T structures from ipc_data.h. Complete IPC interface in one call. Saves ~600 lines.

scan_ci_pipelines.description: [CI/CD] All WRSD pipeline YAML summaries — names, stages, triggers, params. Saves reading 5-10 YAML files.

scan_build_graph.description: [Dependencies] Recursive dep graph for a BUILD target. Pass build_path, target, depth. Saves multiple scan_deps calls.

scan_diff.description: [Git] Structured diff summary vs a ref. Files changed, additions, deletions per file. Saves reading raw diff output.

scan_module_api.description: [Architecture] Combined module overview: functions + defines + includes + structs in one call. Pass module_path. Saves 3-4 separate calls.

scan_todo_fixme.description: [Quality] Find TODO/FIXME/HACK comments in a path. Pass path and optional pattern. Quick tech debt scan.

scan_file_summary.description: [Context] High-level file summary: line count, functions, includes, globals, ifdef guards. One call = full file context without reading it.
